svg.title: Ending: The Shadow Passes
svg.desc: Ending card, The Shadow Passes (as written): the bark above, the yard below. Above, light comes back from the east edge, the people come out of the knots, Twig's kite goes up, Mossa starts up the Long Crack and Fenn lays her ear on the wall. Below, someone walks back across the yard to the house, seen from behind.
svg.text: Even the smallest world is a universe to the ones who live in it.
